title: Apache ZooKeeper
scope: A complete Apache ZooKeeper course covering distributed coordination, the replicated znode data model, sessions and watches, Zab/quorum behavior, ensemble design, client semantics, ACLs and authentication, TLS/SASL, dynamic reconfiguration, observers, recipes, Apache Curator, persistence, monitoring, failure recovery, upgrades, containers/Kubernetes, and production coordination design.
coverage_note: Apache ZooKeeper 3.9.5 current and 3.8.6 stable lines, including modern AdminServer/metrics, TLS, dynamic reconfiguration, observers, multi operations, container/TTL nodes, four-letter-word controls, and production ensemble operations
